name: Common
description: These spells are widely known and often used for very practical applications such as healing or repair. These spells are sometimes watered-down versions of more powerful spells studied by academic institutions.

name: Academic
description: These spells are studied and taught at a university level. They are generally inaccessible to the population at large owing to the expertise they require, but not intentionally kept secret.

name: Forbidden
description: These spells are those widely deemed unethical or dangerous, such as necromancy or demonolatry. If you want to learn these spells, you might have to get your hands dirty. If you choose to learn such spells, be wary of where and when you cast them.

name: Esoteric
description: These spells are not taught by universities, even at a doctoral level. Some of these spells have been lost to time, while others are studied in secret by druidic orders or cultist enclaves. The easiest way to learn esoteric spells is via supernatural assistance.
